data.name: Furnary
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Furnary was the name of a goddess who presided over furnaces and forges. She ensured that the fires were kept burning and the metals were transformed into useful objects. In Christianity, the name Furnary could symbolize a spiritual forge, where one's faith is tested and refined.
